summary: Renamed the forced-QnA flag `-qna` (single-dash, convention-inverted footgun and a substring of the deprecated `--qna` alias) to `--qna-force`, and codified fail-closed exact-token argument parsing across the SRS and the kiwi skills.
approach: SRS-first via sanctioned speckiwi CLI mutations (MCP does not expose statement/AC text edits; CLI does) + test-first TDD (red -> green) for the skill content changes.

srs_edits.change: `-qna` -> `--qna-force` (both occurrences: force + suppress); added fail-closed clause: matches exact token `--qna-force` only (never the `--qna` prefix), unrecognized/single-dash variants hard-error (no silent no-op, no inverted action).
`-qna` -> `--qna-force`; added 'parsed fail-closed as an exact token (never the `--qna` alias it prefixes; unrecognized or single-dash variants hard-error)'.
